name: old-indicator-isolated-arms
activation: Not fixed in advance: each arm version's real activation instant is written by production to experiment_arms.activated_at the first time the engine starts after deploy. Only positions opened at or after that instant exist.
status_at_freeze: BUILT, NOT MERGED, NOT ACTIVE (branch feat/experiment-arms)

code.candidate_builder: apps/server/src/services/market-bias.ts buildIndicatorExperimentCandidate (runs buildIndicatorContract / indicatorTargetMove, the production chain's own code)

candidate_stream: One Old Indicator candidate per production poll of a symbol+mode with a BULLISH/BEARISH read, built side-effect free behind the production chain's stateless gates, whether or not the production slot is free. Built only when at least one arm's slot for that symbol+mode is free.

independent_state_per_arm.slot: one open official position per symbol+mode
independent_state_per_arm.cooldowns: the baseline's rules applied to the arm's OWN official stop-outs: 15 min settle per exchange+mode, confidence >= 80 for the rest of the day after a loss, 60 min same symbol+direction cooldown, 2 same-direction losses per day lock
independent_state_per_arm.parent: as the baseline: no parent block for the Old Indicator beyond the slot; candidate id IND:EXCH:SYMBOL:MODE:DIRECTION:DATE recorded
independent_state_per_arm.exits: own position state: target, stop with trailing (+1R breakeven, +2R entry+1R), bias reversal (2 confident opposite reads across the confirm window), session end; V2 adds the invalidation exit

V2.observed_failure: 30% premium base stop sets the final stop in 575/615 intraday trades (median 2.81 underlying ATR) while the structural level behind price is a median 0.79 ATR away; structure can only widen the stop. Trades whose underlying crossed that level (217/615, sampled MAE) lost -89.4R; 40 later reached target; median option MFE +0.10R.
V2.rule: exit at market when a 15-minute bar that closed after entry closes below behindLevel - 0.25*ATR_at_entry (calls) or above behindLevel + 0.25*ATR_at_entry (puts); behindLevel and ATR as recorded at entry
unchanged: initial stop (so R and cost-in-R equal R0)
V2.downside: cuts trades that recover (40/217 historically); a closing-bar rule exits later and worse than the level
V2.why_not_testable: no underlying or option price path at the crossing instant was recorded

ledgers.official: FILL-1.0: entry at the decision mid; target at min(LTP, target) once LTP reaches it; other exits at the observed LTP; official cost model (estimatedCostPct) in R exactly as backtesting.ts

simulated.target: resting limit filled at the target only when the BID reaches it
simulated.market_exits: bid (stop triggers on LTP, then fills at the bid)
simulated.quote_requirements: two-sided; exchange age <= 60 s (receipt <= 15 s when the exchange time is unknown); feed state DATA_FRESH for ticks; top-of-book quantity >= the position quantity (1 lot); unknown or insufficient size = no fill
simulated.unfillable: entry -> NOT_OPENED; exit -> EXIT_PENDING, keeps observing, fills at the first valid bid; at the session end only a quote from the final 10 minutes may fill, else UNRESOLVED with the last valid bid kept
simulated.costs: fees only (statutory + brokerage); spread is in the prices; a latency/slippage allowance is a separately reported sensitivity
simulated.label: quote-based simulation, not measured execution

sizing: 1 lot per position; results per lot and in R; no portfolio rupee P&L

comparison.primary: each arm minus R0 over identical periods (same engine, same candidate stream), per exchange-session, 90% exchange-session bootstrap
comparison.secondary: R0 versus the production baseline over the same period (engine replication fidelity)
metrics: simulated net R and avg on simulated-closed trades
largest winner share of gross profit
net R excluding the largest winner
rules: negative average = loss reduction at best
no automatic promotion; no promotion because sessions elapsed
minimum before any reading: 20 NSE/BSE exchange-sessions after activation
